race.comment: JUNEAU PETE (1) boasts a strong record this course with six wins and five minors from 14 tries. Comes off a (19.63) win last time, scoring by a nose in a Grade 4 over 340m at this track. Appeals as a leading chance in this. KING GANDO (4) has a strong record this track and trip with three wins and three placings from seven starts. Scored by 12 lengths last time (29.34) in a Other over 515m at Launceston. Looks well placed here and among the chances. BLACKBRUSH BILL (2) was safely held last time out, finishing fifth at Launceston over 515m behind Xara Price (30.36) in a Grade 5. Was in the money the start prior. Has the ability to give this a shake. MANILA PANDA (6) dominated last start. Hard to beat again.
